game.name: Darkest Of Days (USA)
game.desc: In the first person action game Darkest of Days for Xbox 360, the player relives the most terrible days of humanity such as the Battle of Antietam (1862, the bloodiest battle of the Civil War) or the eruption of Vesuvius near Pompeii in 79 AD. The aim is to save the lives of key individuals who were not supposed to be involved in these events.
